bestaetigen.title: SmartHeat found
bestaetigen.description: The Heizungsbrücke add-on (device {geraet}) is ready. Connect it to your SmartHeat account now?

anmelden.title: SmartHeat account
anmelden.description: Sign in with your SmartHeat account. The sign-in is only used for this setup.

schon_eingerichtet.title: Already set up
schon_eingerichtet.description: This device already controls the installation {anlage}. Show SmartHeat in Home Assistant again?

ersetzen.title: Replace device
ersetzen.description: The installation {anlage} is attached to another device. This device replaces it; the learned values are kept.

inventur_zeit.title: Inventory
inventur_zeit.description: Home Assistant did not deliver the inventory in time. Submit to try again.

raeume.title: Room
raeume.description: Room sensors and the desired temperature entity (e.g. the thermostat in the living room).

anlagenwerte.title: Heating values
anlagenwerte.description: Prefilled from the heating integration; please check.

geraet_entfernen.title: Remove device
geraet_entfernen.description: SmartHeat resets the heating of installation {anlage} to the last learned values and releases the device.

progress.inventur: Searching Home Assistant for the heating …
progress.einrichten: The device is applying the settings …

error.too_many: Too many attempts, please wait a moment.
error.uebernahme_fehlgeschlagen: The device could not be claimed.
error.anmeldung_gebunden: This sign-in already belongs to another device.
error.cannot_connect: The SmartHeat service cannot be reached.
error.sitzung_abgelaufen: The sign-in has expired. Please sign in again.
error.wrong_domain: This entity does not fit this field.
error.zone_is_room_target: The desired temperature cannot be a value of the heating itself.
error.entity_wrong_integration: Does not belong to the chosen heating integration.
error.entity_wrong_installation: Belongs to another installation of this integration.

abort.kein_supervisor: SmartHeat needs Home Assistant with add-ons (Supervisor).
abort.addon_fehler: The Heizungsbrücke add-on could not be installed, started or checked. Please try again; details are in the log.
abort.addon_veraltet: Please update the Heizungsbrücke add-on to 1.0.0 and then start the setup again.
abort.addon_mehrdeutig: The Heizungsbrücke add-on is installed more than once. Please remove one installation and try again.
abort.bootstrap_url_ungueltig: The bootstrap_url option of the Heizungsbrücke add-on is invalid. Please correct or clear it and start the setup again.
abort.keine_discovery: The add-on did not report. Please check the add-on log.
abort.keine_anlage: The account has no free, active installation. An installation that still runs on the previous access is moved by a separate step.
abort.inventur_fehler: The installation could not be checked: {grund}
abort.nicht_unterstuetzt: For {integration} there is no complete heating circuit or no released installation profile.
abort.rolle_ohne_kandidaten: Home Assistant reported no suitable entity for {rolle}. Please check the heating integration and start the setup again.
abort.einrichten_zeit: The device did not answer in time. Is the Heizungsbrücke add-on running? Please start the setup again.
abort.keine_konfiguration: The device does not report a configuration yet. Please try again in a few minutes.
abort.entfernen_laeuft: The device cannot be reached right now; the removal continues as soon as it is online.
abort.entfernt: The device has been removed and released.
abort.cannot_connect: The SmartHeat service cannot be reached.
abort.geraet_unbekannt: The device does not belong to this account or is locked ({grund}).
abort.alter_eintrag: This entry comes from a version before 1.0.0. Please remove the entry and set up SmartHeat again.
abort.unknown: Unexpected error; details are in the log.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new mapping has been applied.

options.vaillant_vrc720: Heating curve, zone setpoint and heating limit
options.weishaupt_wwp: Heating curve, room setpoint and summer/winter switch-over
options.weishaupt_wwp_basis: Room setpoint only (without heating curve and summer/winter switch-over)

alter_eintrag.message: This SmartHeat entry comes from a version before 1.0.0 and has to be set up again (move to the add-on as a device).

wunsch_ungueltig.message: The desired temperature must be a number.

alter_eintrag.title: SmartHeat: set up the entry again
alter_eintrag.description: This SmartHeat entry comes from a version before 1.0.0 and no longer works with this version. Please remove the entry and set up SmartHeat again (move to the add-on as a device). Until then the add-on keeps controlling with its last configuration.

geraet_doppelt.title: SmartHeat is running twice
geraet_doppelt.description: {text} Please stop the second Home Assistant instance with the same add-on (e.g. a restored backup).

konfiguration_abgelehnt.title: SmartHeat: setting rejected
konfiguration_abgelehnt.description: The add-on rejected the new setting: {text} Please check it under SmartHeat → Reconfigure.

common.done_status_datenfehler: The add-on reports a data error ({grund}). SmartHeat regulates as soon as the values are valid again; details on the SmartHeat device.
common.done_status_notbetrieb: The add-on cannot reach the SmartHeat server right now and runs in emergency mode. It reconnects on its own; the status is shown on the SmartHeat device.
common.done_status_abo_inaktiv: Your subscription is currently inactive. SmartHeat resumes as soon as it is active.
common.done_status_abo_beendet: Your subscription has ended. The system keeps its base values until the subscription is renewed.
common.done_supervision: The add-on watchdog could not be enabled, please check the log.
common.profile_rejected: The SmartHeat server rejected the chosen heating profile. Please choose another combination or contact support.
common.origin_weather: {role}: {entity} (weather service, your heating has no outdoor sensor)
common.warning_stale: No update for more than 6 hours: {entities}
common.warning_deviation: More than 3 K away from the other room sensors: {entities}
common.warning_write_role_unmatched: Not recognised as part of the chosen heating circuit: {entities}. SmartHeat will write to these entities.
common.warning_poll_interval: The heating integration only polls its values every {entities}. SmartHeat may then not see its own changes in time and treat them as a manual change. Please set the heating integration's update interval to 30 minutes or less.
common.notifications_phones: SmartHeat notifies the selected phones when the control stops, a room sensor fails or a battery runs low.
common.notifications_no_phones: No Home Assistant companion app was found, so SmartHeat can only show its important messages (e.g. when the control stops) as notifications in Home Assistant. Install the companion app on a phone to also receive push messages, e.g. about a failed room sensor or a low battery.
common.addon_ambiguous: The add-on {addon} is installed more than once. Please remove the duplicate installation.
common.addon_outdated: The add-on {addon} is outdated (installed {installed}, required {required}). Please update it.
common.supervisor_unavailable: The Supervisor is not reachable. Please try again.
common.provisioning_failed: The SmartHeat server could not issue access credentials. Please try again later.
common.invalid_provisioning_response: The SmartHeat server returned an incomplete setup response. Please try again later or contact support.
common.verteilsystem_mismatch: The SmartHeat server reported a different heating distribution system than you selected. Setup was cancelled so the wrong safety limits are not applied. Please contact support.
common.setup_unexpected: Unexpected error during setup, see the Home Assistant log.
common.new_credentials: New access credentials will be issued.
common.profile_update_failed: The SmartHeat server could not change the heating profile. Please try again later.
common.options_addon_failed: The Heizungsbruecke add-on could not be updated. Please check the Supervisor and try again.
common.options_restored: The previous Heizungsbrücke settings have been restored.
common.options_restore_failed: The previous Heizungsbrücke settings could not be restored. Please save the options again.
common.removal_incomplete: SmartHeat was removed, but not every step succeeded:
common.rollback_first_setup: The SmartHeat setup was cancelled. The add-ons were stopped and the issued credentials revoked.
common.rollback_reconfigure: “Reconfigure” was cancelled. The previous add-on settings and heating profile have been restored.
common.rollback_first_setup_incomplete: The SmartHeat setup was cancelled, but not every step of the rollback succeeded:
common.rollback_reconfigure_incomplete: “Reconfigure” was cancelled, but not every step of the restore succeeded:
common.rollback_reconfigure_new_access: “Reconfigure” was cancelled. The previous add-on settings and heating profile have been restored; the system keeps the new credentials issued during the attempt.
common.rollback_reconfigure_new_access_incomple: “Reconfigure” was cancelled and the new credentials were kept, but not every step of the restore succeeded:
common.open_step_supervisor: The Supervisor was unreachable. Please stop the add-ons Heizungsbrücke and Cloudflared Access TCP-Bridge manually under Settings → Add-ons.
common.open_step_foreign_tenant: The add-ons belong to another SmartHeat installation and were left untouched.
common.open_step_no_sign_off: Heizungsbrücke did not confirm the sign-off and was stopped anyway. Please check the heating circuit's values in the manufacturer's app: boost values (SmartHeat's local maximum values) may have been left in place.
common.open_step_stop: An add-on could not be stopped. Please stop it manually under Settings → Add-ons.
common.open_step_revoke: The credentials could not be revoked on the SmartHeat server. They will be replaced at the next setup.
common.open_step_clear: The credentials could not be removed from the add-on options. Please uninstall the add-ons if SmartHeat is no longer used.
common.open_step_profile: The previous heating profile could not be restored on the SmartHeat server. Please run “Reconfigure” again.
common.open_step_addons: The previous add-on settings could not be restored. Please run “Reconfigure” again.
common.regelhinweis_vaillant_vrc720: SmartHeat sets the heating zone to "Manual" and controls its target temperature itself; the minimum flow temperature follows your target temperature at the room thermostat.
common.regelhinweis_weishaupt_wwp: SmartHeat sets the heating circuit's operating mode to "Normal" and controls the heating curve, the normal room setpoint and the summer/winter switch itself; it only moves the comfort and setback setpoints when the normal setpoint would not fit between them otherwise.
common.regelhinweis_weishaupt_wwp_basis: SmartHeat sets the heating circuit's operating mode to "Normal" and controls the normal room setpoint itself; the heating curve stays as it is. It only moves the comfort and setback setpoints when the normal setpoint would not fit between them otherwise.
common.regelhinweis_viessmann_vicare: SmartHeat ends an active comfort or eco program and controls the slope, the level and the normal temperature of the heating circuit itself.
